guidance.claim: Net interest margins are at the bottom and will trend upward next quarter.
guidance.quote: The trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards.
guidance.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

guidance.claim: Net interest margin is expected to be neutral to positive going forward.
guidance.quote: So, net of that, we still think that there can be neutral to positive on the margin as we go forward.
guidance.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan

guidance.claim: Retail and MSME growth will continue across the next two quarters.
guidance.quote: And therefore, I think going forward, across the next 2 quarters, you will see that change coming through as we also grow the volumes in retail and MSME.
guidance.speaker: Kaizad Bharucha

reported.claim: Deposits increased 18.8% year-on-year on a reported basis.
reported.quote: Deposits increased 18.8% year-on-year on a reported basis, including a 4 percentage point lift from special FCNR (B) window.
reported.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

reported.claim: CASA grew at about 10.8% on an overall basis.
reported.quote: As you will see in our published deck, CASA grew at about 10.8% on an overall basis.
reported.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

reported.quote: Total AUM grew 15.3% year - on-year, including a 1.9% impact of FCNR (B) leverage, with SME and retail assets leading the charge.
reported.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

reported.claim: GNPA was at 1.11%, which is lower year-on-year.
reported.quote: Our asset quality remains pristine, with GNPA at 1.11%, 13 basis points lower than year- on-year.
reported.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

reported.claim: The bank delivered an ROA of 1.8%.
reported.quote: The bank's well-balanced performance translated to ROA of 1.8%, which has been the range that we've been th ere for a very long time, and quarterly PAT of Rs 19.5 billion, which is a growth of 12.7% approximately if you exclude the trading gains.
reported.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

reported.claim: Credit costs remained low at 44 basis points.
reported.quote: Credit costs remain low at 44 basis points, the risk weights to total assets at 69%.
reported.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan
